description:
[read-only] Every metric the networks report for one published post: reach, impressions, plays, average watch time, watch-through, likes, comments, shares, saves, profile visits, follows and link clicks, per network and in total. Video posts carry the retention curve with the hook window, average view duration and the point where half the viewers had left (`retention`), and the drop points where viewers left faster than usual, each with the transcript line playing then (`dropPoints`; `timeline` null means the video has no transcript yet); other posts carry a funnel from reach to engaged to clicked to converted (`funnel`). `settling` means the network may still change the numbers; `history` holds the 48h, 7d and 30d snapshots. Boosted posts add spend and cost per result (`paid`). A null measure means not reported by that network, never zero.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/posts/{id}/analytics.)
name: get_post_analytics
title: Get one post's analytics
